ModMetaData.name: Bloodsucker 9000
ModMetaData.description:
A butt implant that bleeds its host into one hemogen pack a day. The host was not consulted.
Research Bloodsucker 9000 after Bionics, craft it at a fabrication bench, install it by surgery. A toggle on the pawn's command bar turns it off and on.
While installed: +15% pain, movement 70%. Each tap: bite sound, blood splash, a -15 mood for a day (+15 for masochists). Blood loss stays below the severe stage, so the implant cannot kill by itself.
Requires Biotech. No Harmony. Safe to add to an existing save; remove the implants by surgery before removing the mod.
